column1: Table 13 | Classi<sup>fi</sup>cation for the grade of the certainty of evidence Grade  Certainty of evidence  Meaning    A  High  We are confident that the true effect is close to the estimate of the effect.    B  Moderate  The true effect is likely to be close to the estimate of the effect, but there is a possibility that it is substantially different.    C  Low  The true effect may be substantially different from the estimate of the effect.    D  Very low  The estimate of the effect is very uncertain, and often it will be far from the true effect.
